findings.passage: "We are looking to put teeth into the voter challenge law," said Dolezal, "So, that people that are registered to vote right now at UPS stores, empty buildings, parking lots, under overpasses, finally get off these voting rolls."
findings.note: Quoted by FOX 5 Atlanta about his SB 568; he says the bill would strengthen the voter-challenge law so that people registered at non-residential addresses are removed from the rolls. Article date is its publication date.
